job.title: SAP CX / CRM Consultant (all genders)
job.email_subject: Application: SAP CX / CRM Consultant – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

You need SAP CX consultants who bridge client business and platform – I have done that on SAP Commerce Cloud for 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– Requirements analysis, user stories, functional specifications and UAT with business teams
– PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; SAP ERP / MDM integration
– SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User

I am comfortable in client-facing, international project setups and bring both the consulting and the delivery perspective. My CV and cover letter are attached. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Could we arrange a short call this week or next?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: SAP CX Consultant | SAP Commerce Cloud, Techno-Functional | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: SAP CX consultant with a techno-functional profile and 5+ years implementing and extending SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Translates business requirements into user stories, functional specifications and solution designs, and delivers them hands-on with Java, Spring and OCC REST APIs. Experienced in SAP ERP, PIM and MDM integration, UAT, CCv2 deployment cycles and stakeholder management in international teams. Uses generative AI tools in analysis and delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Accenture shapes large SAP CX transformations, and I want to bring my hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud experience from Rockwell Automation and Shell to that scale. The mix of client consulting, solution design and technical depth in your SAP CX practice matches how I already work, and I am excited about the variety of industries.

en.subject: Application: SAP CX / CRM Consultant
en.hook: Accenture's SAP CX clients need consultants who can design the right customer-experience solution and know exactly how it runs on the platform. That is what I have done for more than five years: analysing requirements with business stakeholders and delivering them on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell – as SAP Certified Developer and Business User.

bullets.label: Business requirements & solution design
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders and product owners, wrote user stories and functional specifications, mapped processes and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) – then translated them into working SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud implementation
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211); developed and maintained the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: Integration with SAP ERP & MDM
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international technical teams.

bullets.label: AI-assisted delivery
bullets.text: Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively to accelerate analysis, development, testing and documentation in day-to-day delivery.

en.logistics: I am comfortable in client-facing, international project setups and bring both the consulting and the delivery perspective. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can contribute from day one.
